Problem Statement:
Given a number N and N strings of length atmost M, print the longest common prefix. 
Input Description:
The input consists of a number N and N strings of length at most M. Constraints: 1<=N, M<=100000. 
Output Description:
The output is the longest common prefix. 
Sample Input:
2
Vishal
Vidharba 
Sample Output:
Vi
